title: Agreement open for abelian etale inverse-image unit sections
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $U\to S$ an etale object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $s,t\in F(U)$. There exists an open $W\subset U$ such that for every scheme morphism $f:X\to S$, the images of $s,t$ under the adjunction unit $F\to f_*f^*F$, evaluated at $U$, agree if and only if the inverse image of $W$ under $U\times_S X\to U$ is the whole scheme. The unit is the canonical inverse-image/direct-image adjunction unit; no compactness or limiting-system hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09XM (lemma-where-sections-are-equal), Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback), and Tag 03S2 (section-extension-by-zero), restriction paragraph.

proof.text: Forget abelian groups to sets and apply the unique agreement-open theorem to F, U, s and t. This supplies W characterized by equality after arbitrary restriction into U.

Prove that the adjoint transpose of the forgotten abelian inverse-image unit is an isomorphism. The forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits, hence pointwise Kan extensions along the opposite etale base-change functor, whose comma categories are filtered. Compose lanCompIsoOfPreserves with sheafComposeNatIso. The sheafification-unit naturality, sheafComposeNatTrans_fac and leftKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves_inv_fac identify this isomorphism with the displayed adjoint transpose. All ingredients here are proved Mathlib constructions; this is the private isIso_abelian_forget_comparison proof. The two concrete unit formulas are obtained directly from Mathlib adjunction restriction/composition and sheafification-unit equations; no duplicate generic pullback_unit_hom declaration is introduced.

Evaluate the adjunction unit equation at U: the preceding comparison sends the set unit images to the abelian unit images. Its component is injective, so the two equality propositions are equivalent. Apply the cartesian-unit equality criterion at the actual base change with the identity isomorphism; this identifies equality with arbitrary restriction along the first pullback projection p.

The defining criterion for W says that this restriction equality is equivalent to factorization of p through the open immersion W to U. A factorization implies every point maps into W. Conversely whole inverse image gives range containment and IsOpenImmersion.lift constructs the factorization. Thus the condition is precisely p inverse-image W = top.

theorem etale_abelian_unit_equal_open
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (U : S.Etale) (s t : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ W : U.left.Opens, ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S),
      (((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).unit.app F).hom.app
          (op U) s =
        ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).unit.app F).hom.app
          (op U) t) ↔
      pullback.fst U.hom f ⁻¹ᵁ W = ⊤
